description: Victorian public holidays as published by Business Victoria (statewide list; metropolitan basis).

evidence.method: Scraped from the official Business Victoria 2026 and 2027 public-holiday pages on the checked date; 2026 page modified 2026-05-21, 2027 page modified 2025-12-02.

uncertain_windows.reason: The Friday before the AFL Grand Final 2027 public holiday has no fixed date until the AFL schedule is released; the publisher states the page will be updated when it is.

caveats: Non-metropolitan councils may substitute an alternate local holiday for Melbourne Cup Day; confirm registry-location holidays before relying on a business-day computation.
ANZAC Day is commemorated on the day it falls with no replacement holiday when it falls on a weekend.
